name: ves-evals
description: Framework-agnostic evals for LLM agents that grade what the agent actually did: tool calls and approvals recorded by the harness, simulated personas, pass^k with confidence intervals, and a deploy gate for CI. Local-first, no telemetry.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.ts run --config examples/plain-node/ves.config.json --tier smoke --connection mock --out results
scripts.demo:personas: node src/cli.ts run --config examples/personas/ves.config.json --tier smoke --connection mock --out results
scripts.smoke:mock: node src/cli.ts run --profile vibiz --tier smoke --connection mock --out results
scripts.release:mock: node src/cli.ts run --profile vibiz --tier release --connection mock --out results
